queries_run: DoorDash autonomous delivery robots drones threat to Dasher model 2026
AI agents ordering food delivery disintermediate DoorDash app ChatGPT Uber Eats 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：資源更多的競爭者可能更快回應新興技術與偏好變化，使 DoorDash 平台吸引力下降或過時；並提及消費者可能採用新出現的替代方案，使市場發展不如預期。
findings.excerpt: Greater financial resources and product development capabilities may allow these competitors to respond more quickly and efficiently to new or emerging technologies and changes in merchant, consumer, and Dasher preferences that may render our platform less attractive or obsolete.

substitute_technology.note: 自動化配送（Dot機器人、DoorDash Air無人機）與AI代理下單（ChatGPT、Gemini、Apple Messages）為搜尋摘要所見，僅以 clues 留存，未讀到可逐字複製原文。

clues.claim: DoorDash 表示 Dasher 仍將是物流骨幹，同時增加地面與空中機器人投資；Dot 預期年底在最大測試市場占高個位數百分比訂單；DoorDash Air 預計2026秋季開始商業配送。
DoorDash 推出 Apple Messages 文字下單 AI 代理；CEO Tony Xu 稱 AI 代理可能處理前幾步，但 DoorDash 能協調整個配送。
clues.source: The Star: DoorDash debuts text-to-order AI agent that works in Apple Messages

clues.claim: DoorDash CEO 論述不懼 AI 購物代理。
clues.source: Restaurant Business: why DoorDash isn't afraid of AI shopping agents
